Name: Build Version 26.3
Command: JAVA_VERSION=25 MC_VERSION=26.3 docker compose -f build/compose.yml run --build --rm builder

Name: Deploy Server 26.3
Command: MC_VERSION=26.3; mkdir -p servers/"$MC_VERSION" && echo 'eula=true' > servers/"$MC_VERSION/eula.txt" && cp "build/versions/$MC_VERSION/spigot-$MC_VERSION.jar" servers/"$MC_VERSION/spigot.jar"

Name: Launch Server 26.3
Command: JAVA_VERSION=25 MC_VERSION=26.3 docker compose -f servers/compose.yml run --rm --service-ports spigot
